description: One detail page for own and federated RDs (D75): every credentialSubject property as a path
and value row, quality for own RDs only, an error and no rows on any error. No schema (D42).

elements.name: The detail of an own resource description shows all properties and the quality

the detail page shows a property row for every property of "own"
the detail page shows the property "simpl:generalServiceProperties/simpl:name" with the value "{token} own data"

elements.name: The detail of a federated resource description looks the same without quality

steps.name: I am logged in to the UI as "consumer-a"
"provider-b" has published a "DataOffering" resource description "partner" discoverable by "PARTNER_CONSUMER"

the detail page shows a property row for every property of "partner"
the detail page shows the property "simpl:providerInformation/simpl:providedBy" with the value "provider-b"
